# Operator Note — Line Startup: Heat Treat Line (SOP-P2-L4-01)

Purpose
Ensure a safe, repeatable startup of the Heat Treat line in accordance with SOP-P2-L4-01. This note highlights critical checks and common issues observed during startup.

Pre-start checks
- Verify that the line area is clear of loose tools, foreign material, and unauthorized personnel.
- Confirm that all protective guards, interlocks, and emergency stops are functional and unlocked.
- Ensure required process documentation and traveler are present at the control station.

Controls and instrumentation
- Confirm control panel is in normal operating mode and communication to upstream/downstream systems is established.
- Check that sensors and thermocouples are reading logically and reporting to the main HMI.
- Confirm atmosphere monitoring and exhaust systems are active and stable before charging.

Material handling and loading
- Verify parts are correctly staged, tagged, and matched to the planned heat schedule per SOP-P2-L4-01.
- Confirm carrier/fixture condition and secure load balancing to prevent jams or misalignment during conveyance.

First run monitoring
- Observe the first loaded parts through the complete process cycle; remain at the control point to respond to alarms.
- Watch for abnormal noises, smells, or vibrations; stop line if any abnormal condition cannot be immediately corrected.

Shutdown and documentation
- If a safe startup is not achieved, perform an orderly shutdown and notify maintenance and supervision.
- Document startup checklist outcomes, any deviations, and corrective actions per SOP-P2-L4-01 before resuming production.
